query:
INSERT INTO eval.labels
        (subject_kind, subject_id, operator_turn_id, session_id, session_uuid, axis, label, tier,
         method, split, tags, severity, confidence, evidence, source, provenance, inclusion_prob,
         import_batch_id)
 SELECT x.subject_kind, x.subject_id, x.operator_turn_id, x.session_id, x.session_uuid::uuid, x.axis,
        x.label, x.tier, x.method, 'holdout', x.tags, x.severity, x.confidence, x.evidence, x.source,
        x.provenance, x.inclusion_prob, $2
   FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
        subject_kind text, subject_id bigint, operator_turn_id bigint, session_id bigint,
        session_uuid text, axis text, label text, tier text, method text, tags text[],
        severity text, confidence text, evidence text, source text, provenance jsonb,
        inclusion_prob double precision)
